title: Snowstep
description: Walk on powder snow and glide across winter biomes without sinking, snowshoes for Minecraft.
body:
# Snowstep
Never falling through snow again!

## Overview
This mod adds a new leather boots upgrade, Snowshoes.
Once equipped, they prevent you from falling through powder snow.
Very handy when exploring snowy biomes packed with powder snow.

## Recipe
Craft Snowshoes with strings on both sides of leather boots and three sticks across the bottom row.

![Snowshoes crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3fdf644d4628988a8f86c71882b7b6e15bac55a3_0.webp)

## Bug report
If you encounter compatibility issues, feel free to report them through [Github](https://github.com/acorsicanfrog/snowstep) — I’ll do my best to fix them!
